name: Button
description: Action control with seven visual variants, two sizes and optional leading or trailing icons.

semantics.nativeAttributes: Forward the target stack's native button attributes and events.
semantics.iconsAria: Treat decorative leading and trailing icons as hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: content
props.description: Visible button label or custom content.

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | accent | outline | selected | dashed | blank | gray

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Decorative icon displayed before the label.

props.name: iconEnd
props.description: Decorative icon displayed after the label.

accessibility: Use the target stack's native button element or button primitive.
Preserve keyboard activation and focus-visible indication.
Forward disabled and other native button semantics.
Hide decorative start and end icons from assistive technology.
Keep a visible label unless the target application supplies an accessible name for an icon-only use.
adaptationRules: Use the target application's existing framework and component conventions.
Use its existing styling system and design tokens where equivalents exist.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any other dependency solely for this component.
Prefer an existing button primitive in the target application and map this contract onto it.
Treat dimensions and colors as reference values when the target design system has no equivalent.
